source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e; routes and dialogue checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

rec: A house teleport if your house is in Rimmington and if you have no faster way to Mudskipper Point
A Camelot/Rellekka teleport (for starting the quest)
Some stamina potions (when collecting the ores)
A ring of wealth/amulet of glory/Varrock teleport

st.t: Enter the Keldagrim entrance tunnel, north-east of Rellekka. Inside, go through the cave entrance straight ahead, between the two statues, and speak to the Dwarven Boatman.
s: That's a deal!
Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.
Yes.

st.t: Finish speaking to Commander Veldaban.
s: Yes, I will do this.

st.t: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor in the east of Keldagrim.
s: Yes, I will do this.

st.t: Talk to Vermundi, the silk trader in the east market, west of Blasidar.
s: Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.

st.t: Talk to the Librarian in the library at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim, across the bridge.
s: Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?

st.t: Climb any bookcase to find a book on costumes.
Talk to Vermundi with the book on costumes.
s: Yes, about those special clothes again...

st.t: Use your coal on the spinning machine next to Vermundi, with logs in your inventory.
Start the spinning machine with a tinderbox.
Talk to Vermundi again and pay 200gp.
s: Yes, about those special clothes again...
I'll pay.

st.t: Talk to Saro at the anvil south-west of the bank in West Keldagrim.
s: Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.

st.t: Talk to Dromund in his house just north of the West Keldagrim bank.
Take the Left boot when Dromund isn't looking.
Take the Right boot from outside his window when he isn't looking using Telekinetic Grab.

sec.n: An axe fit for a king

st.t: Talk to Santiri at the weapon shop in the north-west of West Keldagrim.
s: Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.
Perhaps I can repair the axe?

st.t: Use the 3 sapphires on the axe, then talk to Santiri again.
s: Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.

st.t: Skip this step and the next one if you gave Thurgo a redberry pie during The Knight's Sword. Otherwise, talk to the Librarian about Imcando dwarves.
s: Can you help me find an Imcando dwarf?

st.t: Skip this step if you gave Thurgo a redberry pie during The Knight's Sword. Otherwise, talk to Reldo in Varrock Castle's library.
s: Ask about Imcando dwarves.

st.t: Talk to Thurgo at Mudskipper Point, and keep talking to him until the axe is repaired. Offer him the redberry pie if the option appears.
s: Something else.
Would you like a redberry pie?
Can you help me with this ancient axe?
Can you repair that axe now?
Return to Keldagrim immediately.

st.t: Talk to Riki the sculptor's model to give him the clothes, axe and boots.
s: Return to Keldagrim immediately.

st.t: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor.
Go to the upper floor of the market.

Talk to the secretary of any company except the Red Axe, and only work for that one company. Complete the tasks given. If you don't want a task, tap the secretary again for a different one instead of refusing it. Stop when the secretary says there's no more work and you should speak directly to the director.
s: Is there anything I can help you with?
I'll take it.
Do you have another task for me?

st.t: Keep talking to the director of the same company and complete the tasks given. If you don't want a task, tap the director again for a different one before continuing the chat. Stop when the director asks if you've considered joining the company.
s: Do you have any more tasks for me?
I'll take it.

st.t: Talk to the director to join the company.
s: I'd like to officially join your company.

st.t: Talk to the director after joining the company. For the last choice, pick "Yes! Long live the" followed by your own company's name.
s: Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.
I would support you.

st.t: Talk to Commander Veldaban, west of the bank in West Keldagrim.
s: I'm ready.

i: Some stamina potions (when collecting the ores)
